items.title: REGN Gets FDA Nod for Livsayis in Generalized Myasthenia Gravis

items.title: Regeneron Wins FDA Nod For Livsayis, 4x-Year GMG Shot
items.summary: On Wednesday, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc.’s (NASDAQ:REGN) Livsayis (cemdisiran) for generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) in adults who test positive for anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibodies, the predominant form of the disease. Livsayis stands as the first and only approved small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapy for gMG.
